final: WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(spent) / SUM(amount) AS spend_ratio FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), relative_ratios AS (SELECT event_id, spend_ratio, spend_ratio / (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) FROM event_ratios) AS relative_spend_ratio FROM event_ratios) SELECT event_id, spend_ratio, relative_spend_ratio FROM relative_ratios ORDER BY relative_spend_ratio IS NULL, relative_spend_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
